title: Hurricane modeled annual building loss rate
unit: annual building loss per $10,000 of total building value
period: FEMA model, version 1.20. Input years vary by hazard.
geographyVintage: Census 2021 counties; newer Connecticut planning regions unmatched
note: A FEMA computer model estimates the average damage to buildings from hurricanes each year. The value is the damage in dollars for each $10,000 of building value in the county. The model uses data from different years for different hazards.
